# The spread on announced risk dates: result (#693)

**Hypothesis and step:** H6 (the spread on known risk dates is forecastable), step 1: benchmarks and a first candidate. **Development data only: this is not a verdict** (scoring protocol v1, #640). Generated by `scripts/risk_date_spread_693.py page`; the evidence is in `docs/pivot/evidence/risk-date-spread/`.

Target: the SOFR - IORB spread in bp on 383 quarter-end, month-end, tax and coupon-settlement days to 2025-12-31 (`metadata/risk_date_spread_693.json`). Benchmarks: as-of persistence (B1) and the trailing year's spreads on days of the same risk type. Candidates: the mean-reverting H5 row of #686, and one day-type x scarcity-state model.

| grid CRPS bp | mean | skill vs B1 [90%] | skill vs calendar [90%] |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 persistence | 3.243 | | |
| risk-date calendar | 4.289 | | |
| H5 mean reversion (#686) | 3.139 | +3.2% [+0.0%, +6.6%] | +26.8% [+13.8%, +44.7%] |
| type x state | 4.594 | -41.7% [-92.8%, -18.4%] | -7.1% [-16.6%, -0.8%] |

| MAE of the median bp | mean | skill vs B1 [90%] | skill vs calendar [90%] |
|---|---|---|---|
| B1 persistence | 3.978 | | |
| risk-date calendar | 5.550 | | |
| H5 mean reversion (#686) | 3.950 | +0.7% [-3.2%, +3.6%] | +28.8% [+14.8%, +46.8%] |
| type x state | 6.105 | -53.5% [-116.1%, -24.5%] | -10.0% [-20.8%, -2.8%] |

Not killed on the development data: H5 mean reversion (#686) has skill (the 90% interval of its pooled skill above zero) on CRPS or MAE against both as-of persistence and the risk-date calendar benchmark. This is exploration, not a verdict (scoring protocol v1, #640).

How firm that is: the lower bound of the first candidate's pooled CRPS skill against B1 is +0.03% (the Diebold-Mariano p-value is 0.038), and its MAE has no skill against B1. By regime its CRPS skill against B1 is 2018-19 +4.4% [+2.1%, +11.0%], 2020-24 -1.8% [-11.5%, +5.4%], 2025-26 +5.7% [-0.5%, +11.9%]: the pooled figure leans on the regimes where it is positive. Its skill against the calendar benchmark is large and the type x state model is worse than the calendar benchmark.

The splits by risk type, regime and scarcity state, the per-lead tables and the sketch of the severity calendar (when the rule leaves the hypothesis standing) are in `docs/pivot/evidence/risk-date-spread/report.md`.
